text: Extension of PUSU deadline to 18 November 2026

New addition: Non-binding cash proposal of 46p per share by Autobuses de Leon, S.L. Mobico's independent directors are "minded" to recommend the proposal to Mobico's shareholders. PUSU deadline is 18 November 2026
New HF entrant: Sand Grove declares 1.16%
Receipt of merger control clearance from the European Commission. Completion remains subject to the remaining conditions, including the CMA Condition and the UK National Security Condition
Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 615p per share. Completion is expected by early in the first quarter of 2027
